versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the 微信聊天记录知识卡片提取工具.
- Converts WeFlow-exported JSON chat data into knowledge base entries, knowledge cards, and AI persona training data.
- Supports extraction of customer profiles, common phrases, key decisions, and communication links from chat history.
- Output structured knowledge cards and summaries, with suggested formats for Feishu Bitable integration.
- Offers best practice guidance for organizing, categorizing, and updating extracted knowledge.
